key_information_units.information: Revenue increased to EUR 32.8 million in Q1 2026 (from EUR 20.8 million in Q1 2025), driven by a 35% increase in natural gas transmission volumes and higher 2026 transmission prices.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 25 – Revenue analysis for the period ended 31 March 2026

key_information_units.information: Net profit surged to EUR 15.8 million in Q1 2026 (from EUR 4.2 million in Q1 2025), with EBITDA rising to EUR 23.3 million (from EUR 8.9 million).
Adjusted EBITDA was EUR 8.3 million in Q1 2026, essentially unchanged from EUR 8.3 million in Q1 2025, after adjusting for temporary regulatory differences of EUR 15.0 million.

Natural gas costs decreased 68% to EUR 1.5 million in Q1 2026 (from EUR 4.6 million in Q1 2025) due to reduced balancing gas demand from a new Kaliningrad transit agreement, though technological needs costs rose 118%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 27 – Purchases of natural gas and Note 25 – Revenue analysis

key_information_units.information: Borrowings were reclassified from current to non-current liabilities after resolving covenant breaches; net debt increased to EUR 106.6 million (from EUR 76.1 million at 31 March 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 18 – Borrowings and Note 20 – Net debt

key_information_units.information: Ongoing litigation with contractor Alvora UAB over EUR 5.8 million in guarantee funds received for pipeline construction defects, with a provision recognized for potential repayment.
Post-reporting, the April 2026 General Meeting approved the 2025 financial statements and declared dividends of EUR 9.99 million (EUR 0.056 per share).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 36 – Events after the end of the financial year
